environment_constraints: DO NOT modify application.properties (DB already configured: AWS RDS PostgreSQL via R2DBC). contribution_requirements: Backend base package is com.taxseer. All new packages live under com.taxseer (e.g., com.taxseer.filer, com.taxseer.recipient, etc.). Lombok is on the annotation processor path — use @Getter/@Setter/@NoArgsConstructor/@AllArgsConstructor/@Builder freely. R2DBC repositories extend R2dbcRepository<Entity, Long>. All controllers return reactive types (Mono/Flux). CORS must allow the Angular dev server (localhost:4200) via a WebFlux CorsWebFilter bean.
key_patterns: Existing pattern in com.taxseer.Test: @Table entity with @Id Long id + Lombok, R2dbcRepository interface, @RestController with constructor-injected repo (no @Service layer in Test). New packages WILL add a @Service layer between controller and repo for business logic. Entities use @Table(name='...'). Spring Data R2DBC naming convention: snake_case column = camelCase field auto-mapped. @CreatedDate / @LastModifiedDate require @EnableR2dbcAuditing on TaxseerApplication or a config class. For search-by-query-param, use @RequestParam in controller and pass to repo via @Query with :param binding.
directory_structure: Backend: src/main/java/com/taxseer/ (TaxseerApplication.java + Test/ package — do not touch). src/main/resources/ (application.properties — do not touch, schema.sql — replace). New packages go in src/main/java/com/taxseer/<domain>/. Frontend: src/app/views/taxseer/ — all feature pages live here. data/ holds shared dummy data (to be replaced with services). pages/ has dashboard, filer-details, filing, orders, recipients, settings. layout/ has the top nav. No existing Angular service layer — new services go in src/app/views/taxseer/services/ or src/app/core/api/.
